Salt had crusted its cork, and the paper inside was dry and brittle. The handwriting was careful, almost formal. It described a ship called the Marigold, a storm off the northern shoals, and a request that whoever found the message should light a lamp on the eastern cliff for three nights. He folded the paper, placed it in his coat, and began to carry oil up the hill.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市仍未完全入睡。路灯在空荡的街道上投下昏黄的光，偶尔有一辆出租车缓缓驶过，车灯像一条游动的鱼。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有少数几扇还亮着，那或许是熬夜的人，或许是早起的人。环卫工人推着长长的扫帚，沙沙的声音在巷口回荡。面包店的炉火已经点燃，香气从门缝里悄悄溢出，与雨后潮湿的泥土味混在一起。远处的江面泛着微光，货船的汽笛低低地响了一声，又归于沉寂。这座城市正在慢慢醒来，像一个深呼吸后即将睁眼的人。", "w03": "- Recursion means a task solves itself by solving a smaller copy of itself.\n- It needs a stop point, called the base case, so it does not repeat forever.\n- Each step makes the problem smaller until the answer is simple enough to know right away."}
